gates.G0_data: >=25 industry portfolios and usable market data beginning no later than 1991-01-01
gates.G3_dimension_signal: standardized d_info difference on pre-crisis labels <= -0.20
gates.G5_era_stability: UEID-lite AUC increment over node-only is positive in >=2 defined test eras

decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if G0, G1, G2 and G4 pass; G3/G5 are mechanistic/stability support gates. Otherwise NOT SUPPORTED IN PILOT.
explicit_exclusions: NESS correction is excluded because UEID v3.6 synthetic pilot failed its preregistered NESS gate.
No claim of physical universality or literal finite-size scaling is made for markets.
Industry portfolios are used to reduce constituent survivorship bias; this remains a market pilot, not a trading strategy validation.
